title: KISS Psycho Circus: The Nightmare Child

note.windows: Point it at your copy of KISS Psycho Circus patched to 1.13 (the folder holding client.exe and KPCPatch.rez; the README says how to make it from the CD and the two official patches). The build takes about 15 minutes and 3 GB. Python and the Visual Studio Build Tools are installed if they are missing; the Build Tools are about 3 GB and add 15 to 30 minutes, and Windows asks for permission once.
